Hiring: GenAI Architect (P4/P5) | Pan India
Are you passionate about designing and delivering enterprise-scale Generative AI solutions?
We are looking for experienced GenAI Architects (P4, P5 Grades) to join our growing AI practice and drive next-generation innovation across industries.
Experience: 8-16 Years
Location: Pan India
Key Skills
Generative AI amp; Large Language Models (LLMs)
AI/ML Solution Architecture
AWS, Azure amp; GCP
Databricks amp; Snowflake
RAG Architecture amp; Agentic AI
Prompt Engineering amp; MLOps
Python and Modern AI Frameworks
Enterprise Data amp; Cloud-Native Solutions
If you have a strong background in architecting scalable AI solutions and leading AI transformations, we'd love to hear from you.
Interested candidates can share their updated resume at: purbita.mondal@ltm.com


Mandatory Email Subject Line Format: Data Scientist / GenAI Total Experience – Relevant Experience – Notice Period – Current Location
Email Body Must Include:
Total Experience
Relevant Experience in GenAI / AIML
Exp in AWS/Azure/GCP
Notice Period
Current Location
Current CTC
Expected CTC


Profiles without relevant GenAI / AIML handson experience may not be considered.
